name: guardianbot
description: Provider-neutral, reusable GitHub security review platform

scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @guardianbot/protocol && npm run build --workspace @guardianbot/core && npm run build --workspace @guardianbot/defectdojo && npm run build --workspace @guardianbot/monitoring && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && npm run docs:check
scripts.docs:build-cli: npm run build --workspace @guardianbot/protocol && npm run build --workspace @guardianbot/core && npm run build --workspace @guardianbot/guardianctl
scripts.docs:check: npm run docs:build-cli && npm run docs:test && node scripts/check-docs.mjs
scripts.docs:check:external: npm run docs:build-cli && npm run docs:test && node scripts/check-docs.mjs --external
scripts.schemas:check: npm run build --workspace @guardianbot/protocol && node scripts/export-protocol-schemas.mjs --check && node scripts/check-schemas.mjs
scripts.check: npm run schemas:check && npm run lint && npm run scripts:test && npm test && npm run build
